summary: All editions align on core chemical identity, physical states, Earth coverage (~71%), distribution percentages, and hydrological cycle. Divergences appear in specialized emphases: EN uniquely highlights the 'universal solvent' label, triple point proximity, and quantified economic uses (agriculture 70%, protein 6.5%); AR and TA add human-access statistics and scarcity projections absent from EN.
